correctness_confidence.basis: All explicit algebraic identities, exact rational bounds (C01-C16), Fabry-Perot cutoffs, Wiener EMT partitions, AM-GM Lorentz minima, Chebyshev-Cassini recurrences, and water/D2O Q-ceilings check out arithmetically against the stated equations. Only minor continuum modeling approximations affect prefactors without altering the no-go conclusions.

rigor.basis: The manuscript cleanly delineates what is proved over Z in Lean 4 without Mathlib versus what rests on continuum Maxwell approximations and unrefereed empirical inputs [8]. Minor imprecision appears in framing bare constant-damping strong-coupling inequalities with frequency-dependent gamma_c(omega_+) and trivializing physical scaling in Thms 17-18.

novelty.basis: The underlying electrodynamic laws (LST relation, Fabry-Perot cutoff, uniaxial EMT, Abeles transfer matrices, dielectric Q-bounds) are classical. Novelty lies in their exact algebraic synthesis (notably the zero-calculus AM-GM Lorentz minimum and constructive Pell-Chebyshev bound) applied to audit the 71-THz mito-polariton hypothesis and formulate an H2O/D2O dual-branch test.

significance.basis: Provides sharp quantitative constraints that any valid microscopic explanation of the unrefereed 71-THz mitochondrial feature in [8] must overcome (16.7x-100x oscillator-strength enhancement, absence of single-crista FP/Bragg/Lorentz-hyperbolic confinement, and severe H2O O-H wing broadening at 106.6 THz). Impact depends on independent replication of [8].

reproducibility.basis: All parameters, rational expressions, 18 theorem statements, 16 certificate summaries, and figure data match internally, and the Lean/Python verification architecture is clearly specified. However, rational phase approximations t_L, t_W for C11-C12 are omitted from the PDF, and external code/certificates could not be inspected or executed from the PDF alone.

summary: This manuscript presents a rigorous, self-contained electrodynamic constraint audit of the unrefereed 71-THz mitochondrial cristae polariton hypothesis of Yang, Gu, and Song [8], building on the author's Hopfield A^2 invariants [4]. Using exact rational arithmetic, continuum Maxwell reductions, and a reported 18-theorem Lean 4.36.0 formalization, the author establishes five constraints: (i) the homogeneous LST sum rule requires f_req = 6390784/38155329 (~0.1675), demanding >16.75x enhancement over fluid CH2 bulk strength (f_bulk = 0.01), deepening to ~88-117x under partial lipid fill; (ii) the 87-THz Fabry-Perot half-wave thickness (>1188 nm) exceeds a 30-nm crista by >39.6x; (iii) exact uniaxial EMT combined with a clean AM-GM damped Lorentz minimum shows Re(eps_L) > 0 everywhere for fluid bilayers and unconditionally at 71 THz < 87 THz; (iv) SL(2,Q) transfer matrices and a constructive Pell-Chebyshev induction bound (|U_{S-1}(x)| <= S) place 30-nm crista stacks deep in the passband (R_S < 0.5%); and (v) aqueous loss at Gamma_W = 5/6 yields Q_loss(71) = 106.8 versus Q_loss(106.6) = 3 in H2O, rising 35.2x to 105.6 in D2O at the cost of ~75-THz O-D overlap with MP-. While minor modeling approximations exist in the Gamma_L scaling, constant-eps'_eff approximation, and frequency-dependent polariton linewidth criterion, every core calculation and no-go conclusion is sound.
strengths: Exact rational arithmetic and closed-form identities in Eqs. (1)-(11), Table 1, and Table 2 (C01-C16) verify cleanly without discrepancy.

Section 2.2 gives an elegant, elementary AM-GM square-identity proof of the exact global minimum of Re(eps_L) and Reststrahlen threshold 2/Q_m + 1/Q_m^2, rigorously ruling out Lorentz hyperbolicity below 87 THz.
Section 2.3 and Thms 11-13 provide a clean algebraic SL(2,Q) transfer-matrix formulation and constructive Pell-Chebyshev induction bound |U_{S-1}(x)| <= S inside the passband |x| <= 1.

Section 2.4 identifies a sharp experimental asymmetry: H2O is transparent at 71 THz (Q_loss = 106.8) but severely damps the 106.6-THz upper polariton (Q_loss = 3), whereas D2O clears 106.6 THz by 35.2x while perturbing 71 THz via the ~75-THz O-D band.
Section 3 maintains strong epistemic hygiene, explicitly separating algebraic statements verified over Z from continuum Maxwell derivations and unrefereed empirical parameters from [8].
weaknesses: Section 2.1 scales f_req(Gamma_L) = f_req(1)/Gamma_L using the unweighted |E|^2 fraction Gamma_L = 1/6, omitting the permittivity ratio eps_inf,L / eps_eff,inf ~ 2.1025/1.834 ~ 1.15 (which lowers the >100x deficit to >87.6x unless Gamma_L is defined as electrostatic energy fraction or normal-field continuity suppresses |E_L|^2).

Section 2.4 evaluates cavity damping gamma_c(106.61 THz) = 35.54 THz at the upper polariton frequency and inserts it into the constant-damping bare-sum inequality gamma_c + gamma_m > 2g, whereas 50/50 Hopfield mixing gives MP+ FWHM ~(gamma_c(106.6)+gamma_m)/2 ~ 18.3 THz and MP- FWHM ~0.83 THz (sum ~19.1 THz < 35.61 THz).

Section 2.4 uses pure-water eps'_W (1.78, 1.75, 1.76) as eps'_eff for both Gamma_W = 1 and Gamma_W = 5/6 (Thm 15), neglecting the ~4% contribution from the lipid fraction (eps_inf = 2.1025) and dispersive Brillouin energy-density corrections near the 102-THz O-H stretch.
Several Lean theorems (Thms 4, 17, 18) certify trivial integer inequalities whose physical interpretations (collective density scaling, four-protocol decidability) reside solely in prose.

The PDF omits the explicit rational tangent parameters t_L, t_W used to approximate transcendental optical phases in C11-C12, and Figure 3(b) plots dimensionless Q_loss and frequency gamma_c (THz) on a single shared y-axis.
potential_errors: Calling 4g > gamma_c + gamma_m the Rayleigh pole-splitting threshold on p. 3 is slightly imprecise: real pole splitting in a damped two-oscillator model occurs at 4g > |gamma_c - gamma_m|, while 4g > gamma_c + gamma_m is already the peak-separation > polariton-FWHM criterion for frequency-independent gamma_c.

Claiming that gamma_c(106.61) + gamma_m > 2g implies overlapping polariton wings omits Hopfield hybridization (factor of 1/2) and the quiet 71-THz lower branch; the two polariton peaks do not overlap each other (Gamma_+ + Gamma_- ~ 19.1 < 35.61 THz), though MP+ itself is strongly broadened (Q_loss = 3).

Describing F_enh as a 'local-field or subwavelength mode-volume enhancement factor' (p. 2) conflates density/local-field enhancement with mode-volume compression: for a homogeneous medium filling the mode volume, g is independent of V_mode and depends only on oscillator density and filling factor.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact zero-calculus AM-GM algebraic derivation of the global minimum of Re(eps_L(omega)) and Reststrahlen sign-reversal threshold f_osc > 2/Q_m + 1/Q_m^2 for damped Lorentz oscillators (Eqs. 8-9, Thms 8-9).
Constructive mathlib-free Pell-Chebyshev induction proof of the quadratic passband reflectance bound |U_{S-1}(x)| <= S for unimodular SL(2,Q) lamellar stacks (Thms 11-13).
H2O/D2O isotopic titration formulated as a dual-branch diagnostic exploiting the 35.2x recovery at 106.6 THz against the ~75-THz O-D overlap with MP- at 71 THz (Table 3, C14-C16).
